title: Double It And Give It To The Next Person
description: Oh no, a creeper! Double it and give it to the next person.
body:
A creeper is going to explode! What do you do? Double it and give it to the next person, of course!

With this mod, whenever a creeper is about to explode, you are given a choice: do you let the creeper explode? Or do you instead... double it and give it to the next person?

Play this mod with some friends for the best experience.

Warning: the blast strength of a creeper is uncapped, so you should make frequent world backups if you plan to use this mod on a world you care about.
